summary: Added an additive, offline name/phrase-binding evaluator (scripts.eval_harness.name_binding_eval, name_binding_eval/v1 input, name_binding_eval_report/v1 output) for the IDWEAVE L13 wrong-binding ledger, with a synthetic plumbing example and 37 scoped tests. RED was observed and predicted before implementation (collection ModuleNotFoundError). GREEN: 37 passed; ruff format and ruff check clean on owned files. The evaluator consumes precomputed proposals only: no model, network, or similarity library is imported, and no production path, golden, threshold, or sealed registry was changed. The fixture is synthetic plumbing; no empirical winner is declared and no accuracy claim is made.

findings.summary: ADR-018 section 13 requires the wrong-binding ledger to be zero on fixtures. This report has no single gate total. A name on a stranger or unnamed person is counted as unbound_phrase_bindings, prohibited additions are counted separately, and gold wrong_person outcomes overlap both.
findings.follow_up: Decide the zero-gate definition and its de-duplication rule before any gate consumes this report. Do not sum the categories naively.

findings.summary: ADR-018 section 13 says gold associations are required for every fixture. The task brief asked for validation of empty gold, so the evaluator accepts an image with zero gold bindings and returns null rates with unbound counts. The two requirements conflict.
findings.follow_up: Decide whether a fixture with zero gold bindings is refused or allowed as a diagnostic-only state.

findings.summary: ADR-018 section 13 lists a no-naming baseline and a presence-appendix baseline. The evaluator does not generate baselines. A fixture must declare an all-abstain arm to act as the no-naming reference.
findings.follow_up: Add baseline arms to the fixture contract if a comparison is required.

limitations: Synthetic plumbing fixture only. No empirical winner is declared (ranking is null), and no accuracy, face-identification, or caption-quality claim is made.
Only the scoped tests were run. The full suite was not run, per the brief. mypy was not run.
No network, GPU, deploy, OCI provisioning, or subagent was used. Canon rules were taken from the supplied canon-context v0.26.2 rows only; heuristics-canon was not fetched.
Python ran from the repo .venv (a sandbox lane symlink) read-only. Nothing was installed and no shared runtime was modified.

Classification is per gold binding. A prediction on a phrase with no gold binding is reported as unbound_phrase_bindings and is not in the gold partition. A role swap is visible as wrong_person with misattributed_to_phrase set.
Partial coverage is reported explicitly. Rates keep the frozen gold denominator, so a missing record lowers recall rather than being excluded. Rates are null when no image was scored.
The schema has no numeric fields, so the non-finite-value check is not applicable. Any future numeric field must add that validation.
input_sha256 is the digest of the raw input bytes. Reproducibility depends on the fixture bytes being unchanged.
The report commit is the last commit on the branch and cannot list its own SHA. .task-state/ is gitignored, so the report was force-added; 8 .task-state files are already tracked.
The codemap and semantic-context attachments referenced /Users/daniel paths outside this sandbox and were not used. model-research.json is unrelated to this evaluator and was not used.

canon_rules_cited.use: Predicted the exact first failure message before the RED run; the prediction matched.
A missing arm-image record is a distinct explicit outcome, not abstention and not success; abstention is a valid, separately counted result.
The report carries input SHA-256 and the source anonymous-base digest with generation and reweave IDs; a prediction with a mismatched digest is refused.
Lineage: every per-image ledger row points at its frozen image, phrase, and gold person IDs.
Per-arm aggregates and a per-image ledger for every arm; no single pooled score.
Measurement integrity: denominators come from the frozen fixture, not from what an arm predicted (also Principle 15).
Unknown is a designed state: missing_record and empty-gold rates are null rather than zero.
The machine-consumed contract is schema-versioned, extra keys are forbidden, and invalid input is refused fail-closed (exit 1, no output written).
